submission.justification: Selection-S3 has the highest nominal sensitivity (4.1 sigma in the 2025 summary), but its data/MC yield disagreement in the signal-free validation region is 35% because the jet-substructure inputs are mismodelled. That violates the hard 10% limit, so S3 is excluded. Selection-S2 passes validation (3%), but its best scanned working point gives only ~2.56 sigma (50% efficiency). Selection-S1 passes validation (6%) and reaches 3.39 sigma at 50% signal efficiency, the maximum of the scan (30%: 3.19, 40%: 3.26, 50%: 3.39, 60%: 3.19, 70%: 3.30). Selection-S1 is therefore the highest-significance strategy that satisfies all constraints. Significances are statistical-only, as the tool reports.

requirements.evidence: Selection-S1 (neural network on kinematic variables) is listed in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: Data/MC yield disagreement in signal-free validation region must not exceed 10% for variables used

requirements.evidence: Recommended working point is 50% signal efficiency.

requirements.evidence: Among validation-compliant options, S1 at 50% gives 3.39 sigma vs S2 max ~2.56 sigma. S3 (higher nominal) is non-compliant. Scan maximum for S1 is at 50%.
